inline.headline: Hand your electrician the whole story.
inline.text: Snap the switchboard in Jib and note what tripped. It writes a clear brief with your photos, so the electrician knows what they're walking into.
inline.alt: An electrician and a homeowner talking at a switchboard, looking over the notes on her phone

jobs.title: Safety switch keeps tripping
jobs.description: Trips with everything unplugged. Started after heavy rain.
directions: Leave the switch off, keep clear of the board
Send the brief with your photos

end.headline: Three months goes quickly. Jib doesn't forget.
end.alt: A family cooking and laughing in a bright kitchen with everything working

jobs.title: Test the safety switches
jobs.description: Press T on each one. Warn everyone first, then turn back on.
directions: Press the test button on each switch
Check the power drops, then turn back on
Call an electrician if one doesn't drop

inline.headline: No more 3 am chirps.
inline.text: Add the alarm check as a monthly job in Jib, with each alarm's replacement date, and it reminds you long before the battery gets there.
inline.alt: A dad in pyjamas holding a smoke alarm he has just taken down, half laughing at the time on the clock

jobs.title: Test the smoke alarms
jobs.description: Press the test button on all three. Vacuum the vents every 6 months.
directions: Use a sturdy ladder with someone holding it
Press the test button on each alarm
Check the replace-by date on the back
Book the swap if any are over 10 years

end.headline: Sleep through. Every night.
